Q1: Glycolic acid presents recognized Tier 1 hazards for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity (CMR), oral, dermal/eye, and organ/systemic effects. Potential environmental and inhalation hazards are identified at Tier 2. Data for endocrine disruption are currently insufficient for assessment, placing it in Tier 4 for this hazard class.
Q2: Glycolic acid does not appear on any lists of concern or low hazard. This absence may reflect a lack of comprehensive study in some areas, as indicated by data deficiencies in its hazard profile.
Q3: Glycolic acid is extensively studied in the scientific literature, with 28,000 references, and has a clearly defined molecular structure. While it has some toxicological data with 17 ToxValDB records, it has not undergone the most rigorous EPA evaluations (IRIS or PPRTV), and data for endocrine disruption are limited.
